versions.content: Safety Measures expressible within AUTOSAR Models Type: valid Description: Safety Measures shall be expressible within AUTOSAR models. Rationale: AUTOSAR provides a number of safety mechanisms. They should be related to the safety requirements in AUTOSAR models to demonstrate the proper realization of the safety requirements. Furthermore, it is important to also be able to address safety measures that are external to AUTOSAR, but which are important for the AUTOSAR system. By modeling a safety measure it can be used as a proxy and end point for traceability within an AUTOSAR model. Use Case: [UC_SAFEX_00001], [UC_SAFEX_00002], [UC_SAFEX_00006] Dependencies:  Supporting Material: 
